name: ShuratCode-skills
description: Shaked Eyal's personal skills for Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Cowork).

plugins.name: fresh-review
plugins.description: Understand-first, fresh-eyes code review: it explains the change at a high level (the system in brief, behavior before and now, how it fits, a UML class diagram and a sequence diagram, the alternatives), checks with open questions that you know what the change is, then reviews the implementation with context-isolated subagents — a fast implementation pass and the gstack security audit, lattice only when the feature has a lattice context, Codex on request or on high-risk diffs. Findings print the code they want to change, block only with a concrete failure, and the added comments are listed to drop. PR mode adds a risk class; the gstack review army is opt-in (--army); stack mode plans the reviews of a PR stack; a re-review (--delta) reviews only what changed since the last review and checks the earlier blockers.

plugins.name: upgrade-all
plugins.description: One-shot local maintenance: Homebrew, gstack, and Claude Code plugin updates.

plugins.name: pull-all
plugins.description: Recursively fast-forward the main branch of every git repo under a path.

plugins.name: restaurant-search

plugins.name: vault-tools
plugins.description: Route, ingest, query, lint, book-digest, book-note, and podcast operations for an LLM-maintained Obsidian second-brain vault, each deferring to the vault's AGENTS.md.

plugins.name: second-brain

plugins.name: worktree-cleanup
plugins.description: Safely clean up git worktrees: dry-run classification, then delete only user-approved ones, never those with uncommitted changes or unpublished commits.
